// Startseite (Modul 7): "Aggregierte Kennzahlen-Kacheln, verlinkt in alle anderen Seiten"
// (HUMAN_IN_THE_LOOP_ARCHITECTURE.md Abschnitt 2) - bewusst nur Zaehlwerte, keine Listen (die
// liefert bereits Lernen-und-Feedback). Systemstatus-Kachel liest erstmals
// trading.workflow_errors (Abschnitt 9, Phase-1-Fund 8: bisher schreibend, nie lesend genutzt).
const sql = `SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.recommendations r
       LEFT JOIN trading.recommendation_decisions rd ON rd.recommendation_id = r.id AND rd.status = 'aktuell'
       WHERE r.status = 'offen' AND (rd.id IS NULL OR rd.entscheidung IN ('beobachten', 'spaeter'))) AS trade_ideen_anzahl,

    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.paper_trades WHERE status = 'open') AS offene_positionen_anzahl,

    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.paper_trades pt
       LEFT JOIN trading.trade_reviews tr ON tr.trade_id = pt.trade_id
       WHERE pt.status = 'closed' AND tr.id IS NULL) AS trade_reviews_anzahl,

    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.news_items ni
       JOIN trading.v_news_latest_assessment vla ON vla.news_id = ni.id
       LEFT JOIN trading.news_review_notes nrn ON nrn.news_id = ni.id
       WHERE vla.confirmation_status = 'unconfirmed' AND nrn.id IS NULL) AS news_reviews_anzahl,

    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.news_false_negative_flags
       WHERE status IN ('possible_false_negative', 'filter_revision_required')) AS auffaellige_regeln_anzahl,

    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.learning_rule_proposals WHERE status = 'proposed') AS lernvorschlaege_anzahl,

    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.workflow_errors WHERE occurred_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS systemfehler_24h,
    (SELECT max(occurred_at) FROM trading.workflow_errors) AS letzter_systemfehler;`;

return [{ json: { sql } }];
